0022600196.text: The Chicago Bulls, hosting at home, are 1-7 and 0-2 at home, sitting 14th in the East and 5 games back in the Central after a six-game losing streak. The Philadelphia 76ers are 8-1, first in the Atlantic and in the East, riding a five-game winning streak, and they have one more game to play before this one, with Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) both out. The Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia on November 2, following a 2-1 Bulls series win in 2025-26, and Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring strain while Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (undisclosed) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
